absolutely love Coggeshall doctors but after 7 years we decided to move and were surprised how quick we received a call to say we weren’t eligible to remain because we were not in the catchment area anymore which is understandable but when I received the call I explained we were having trouble finding another GP and needed time…….the next day we had no GP !!!!!
